permissions.description: Fixed api.openai.com HTTPS; encrypted API key or protected RuntimeConnection. Explicit per-operation confirmation for billable/mutating actions. No retries, provider calls during build/tests, binary upload parts or automatic tool execution. Event ingress requires explicit administrator profiles, saved secret references and provider/relay setup. Installation never provisions subscriptions or executes trigger code.

definitions.name: Create Embeddings
definitions.documentation: Create Embeddings. One fixed api.openai.com/v1 HTTPS request; redirects disabled, credentials omitted, retries=0. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation=openai:create-embeddings. Billable actions may incur model, storage, search or batch costs; reconcile uncertain outcomes before a deliberate retry. Caller selects explicit model IDs; no fabricated model enum, fallback or substitution. Responses are nonstream text/message/function-call/reasoning data; function calls are NEVER executed. Only function tool declarations, no provider-hosted tools. Named typed contracts preserve supported optional/null/falsy values; unknown response fields are projected away. Unsupported output item kinds fail. 1 MiB request/response; 100–30000 ms total deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and includes awaited cleanup. Strict Unicode/UTF-8, dense arrays, finite safe integers; unsafe numeric integer tokens reject rather than round. One page, never autopagination or polling. Protected OPENAI_API_KEY/apiKeySecret or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken; optional validated project/organization headers. No ambient credentials, arbitrary HTTP URL, binary transfer, multipart parts, streaming, Assistants endpoints, account creation or real provider verification. Upload creation/cancellation manages metadata only; bytes/parts must be supplied externally. Sources: https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/responses https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/embeddings/methods/create https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/models https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/files https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/batches https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/vector_stores https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/uploads

definitions.name: Create Batch
definitions.documentation: Create Batch. One fixed api.openai.com/v1 HTTPS request; redirects disabled, credentials omitted, retries=0. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation=openai:create-batch. Billable actions may incur model, storage, search or batch costs; reconcile uncertain outcomes before a deliberate retry. Caller selects explicit model IDs; no fabricated model enum, fallback or substitution. Responses are nonstream text/message/function-call/reasoning data; function calls are NEVER executed. Only function tool declarations, no provider-hosted tools. Named typed contracts preserve supported optional/null/falsy values; unknown response fields are projected away. Unsupported output item kinds fail. 1 MiB request/response; 100–30000 ms total deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and includes awaited cleanup. Strict Unicode/UTF-8, dense arrays, finite safe integers; unsafe numeric integer tokens reject rather than round. One page, never autopagination or polling. Protected OPENAI_API_KEY/apiKeySecret or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken; optional validated project/organization headers. No ambient credentials, arbitrary HTTP URL, binary transfer, multipart parts, streaming, Assistants endpoints, account creation or real provider verification. definitions.name: Search Vector Store
definitions.documentation: Search Vector Store. One fixed api.openai.com/v1 HTTPS request; redirects disabled, credentials omitted, retries=0. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation=openai:search-vector-store. Billable actions may incur model, storage, search or batch costs; reconcile uncertain outcomes before a deliberate retry. Caller selects explicit model IDs; no fabricated model enum, fallback or substitution. Responses are nonstream text/message/function-call/reasoning data; function calls are NEVER executed. Only function tool declarations, no provider-hosted tools. Named typed contracts preserve supported optional/null/falsy values; unknown response fields are projected away. Unsupported output item kinds fail. 1 MiB request/response; 100–30000 ms total deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and includes awaited cleanup. Strict Unicode/UTF-8, dense arrays, finite safe integers; unsafe numeric integer tokens reject rather than round. One page, never autopagination or polling. Protected OPENAI_API_KEY/apiKeySecret or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken; optional validated project/organization headers. No ambient credentials, arbitrary HTTP URL, binary transfer, multipart parts, streaming, Assistants endpoints, account creation or real provider verification. Upload creation/cancellation manages metadata only; bytes/parts must be supplied externally. Sources: https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/responses https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/embeddings/methods/create https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/models https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/files https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/batches https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/vector_stores https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/uploads

Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation=openai:create-upload. Billable actions may incur model, storage, search or batch costs; reconcile uncertain outcomes before a deliberate retry. Caller selects explicit model IDs; no fabricated model enum, fallback or substitution. Responses are nonstream text/message/function-call/reasoning data; function calls are NEVER executed. Only function tool declarations, no provider-hosted tools. Named typed contracts preserve supported optional/null/falsy values; unknown response fields are projected away. Unsupported output item kinds fail. 1 MiB request/response; 100–30000 ms total deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and includes awaited cleanup. Strict Unicode/UTF-8, dense arrays, finite safe integers; unsafe numeric integer tokens reject rather than round. One page, never autopagination or polling. Protected OPENAI_API_KEY/apiKeySecret or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken; optional validated project/organization headers. No ambient credentials, arbitrary HTTP URL, binary transfer, multipart parts, streaming, Assistants endpoints, account creation or real provider verification. Upload creation/cancellation manages metadata only; bytes/parts must be supplied externally. Sources: https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/responses https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/embeddings/methods/create https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/models https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/files https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/batches https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/vector_stores https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/uploads

definitions.name: OpenAI Response Finished (Relay) Event
definitions.description: Typed event emitted by OpenAI Response Finished (Relay).
definitions.documentation: Event output contract for OpenAI Response Finished (Relay). This trigger accepts the canonical version-1 openai envelope only; it does not authenticate or decode native provider requests. Required exact provider verification: Use the official OpenAI SDK webhook verifier with raw body and webhook-id/webhook-timestamp/webhook-signature headers and endpoint signing secret. Verify standard-webhooks timestamp/replay rules and project ownership; plain body-only HMAC is incompatible. Mapping: Map verified event.id/type/created_at and data.id; accountId is the authorized OpenAI project. Emit only asynchronous resource references; do not include prompts, completions, file contents, metadata or personal data. Canonical eventType values: response.completed, response.failed, response.cancelled, response.incomplete. Required envelope: version=1, provider=openai, deliveryId, eventType, occurredAt (UTC ISO milliseconds), accountId, resource as the typed output schema. Omit no required fields; use explicit null where allowed. Filters accountId/resourceId are exact matches; blank disables a filter. At most 100 account+delivery IDs within 96 KiB deduplicate retries per group; state commits on trigger success before downstream completion. Relay and project webhook setup are separate manual prerequisites. A completed event contains a resource reference; it does not fetch model output or execute an additional model request. Sources: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/webhooks https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/webhooks/methods/create

ingressRequirements.name: OpenAI asynchronous job webhooks relay
ingressRequirements.description: Manual prerequisite: separately maintained exact provider authentication/normalization relay. This release only accepts header-authenticated canonical envelopes from that relay.
setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; no relay or subscription is installed.
Deploy an independently maintained provider-aware relay which implements the exact provider signature, challenge, authorization and replay rules described below.

Use the official OpenAI SDK webhook verifier with raw body and webhook-id/webhook-timestamp/webhook-signature headers and endpoint signing secret. Verify standard-webhooks timestamp/replay rules and project ownership; plain body-only HMAC is incompatible.

Map verified event.id/type/created_at and data.id; accountId is the authorized OpenAI project. Emit only asynchronous resource references; do not include prompts, completions, file contents, metadata or personal data.

Implement the exact canonical version-1 envelope and typed resource schemas documented by each selected trigger; forward one event per POST. Normalize account identity from the authorized provider connection, never from an untrusted request.

Persist one stable delivery ID per logical event across relay retries. Fanout IDs must include distinct native entity/event/status identity (or a persisted record ID); reusing a batch delivery ID or message ID across different statuses drops events. Authorize account/resources; bound payloads to 64 KiB and limit rate.
Save a separate relay-to-ONF callback secret; create a header-authenticated ingress profile for this requirement.
Bind the intended trigger node, configure the relay with its HTTPS callback URL, then deliberately enable workflow and entry.
Review relay limits, delivery identifiers, retries and downstream idempotency; test explicitly before production use.

Select saved node entry mode webhook explicitly; package metadata does not infer it. Create/select a profile for this exact installed requirement (installation.id + "/verified-events"), bind node.trigger.ingress.profileId, save the graph and deliberately enable workflow and entry only when setup is complete.

network.purpose: Provider HTTPS callbacks reach the independently deployed relay; ONF uses its existing HTTPS publication.
